newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 72.1 bln marks in tender at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 72.1 bln marks in tender at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it allocated 72.1 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a three percent fixed rate.
The central bank said it accepted 26.7 percent of the bids.
A repo pact for 70.9 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires Wednesday, so a net 1.2 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 270.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since August 1996.
